## Technical & Design Stack
- **Frontend & Web**: React, Next.js 16 (App Router / Turbopack), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Three.js / WebGPU, GSAP, HTML5/CSS3 Semantics.
- **Backend & APIs**: Node.js, Express, Python (Flask / FastAPI), PostgreSQL, Prisma, SQLite, REST APIs, GraphQL.
- **AI & LLM Orchestration**: Gemini API, Claude API, OpenAI API, RAG Systems, Vector Databases, Prompt Engineering, Automated Document Validation.
- **Mobile & Desktop**: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Google Maps SDK, Electron.
- **Graphic & Product Design**: Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe InDesign, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, Figma, UI/UX Engineering, Brand OS Systems, Wayfinding & Señalética, Print & Merchandising.

## Key Projects
- **ProveedHub AI Platform**: Automated legal document validation (RUT, Cámara de Comercio) using Gemini API & Computer Vision. (React, Express, Gemini API, Electron).
- **ERP Supply Chain**: Enterprise supply chain system with Certicámara digital signature and multi-level approvals. (React, Node.js, SQLite, Certicámara).
- **Conquista la Ciudad**: Native Android mobile application with geo-gamification. (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Google Maps SDK).
- **Langers para Mobil**: Corporate brand identity and graphic design system. (Illustrator, Photoshop, Branding).
- **San Juan Plaza**: Commercial visual identity, signage, and wayfinding system. (Graphic Design, Visual Identity, Signage).
- **Manual de Marca**: Comprehensive brand guidelines and typography manual. (InDesign, Typography, Brand Guidelines).
